video_prompt: One continuous full-frame close-up shot in a modern studio with light-grey hexagonal acoustic panels and clean neutral light; the video fills the whole frame edge to edge from the first frame to the last. Locked-off camera on a tripod; the background stays still. The woman talks toward the right, where the other host sits off-camera, confident and knowing, explaining something, with small natural head movements.
